title: fix: respect iframe sandbox flags on the OpenURL navigation path

target.summary: For non-CURRENT_TAB dispositions, params.frame_tree_node_id identifies the target frame and is unset, causing initiator to always resolve to null. Consequently, the WebSandboxFlags::kPopups check never executes and sandboxed iframes can still open new windows.
notes: resolves initiator frame via params.frame_tree_node_id which is unset for non-CURRENT_TAB dispositions
